messages:
Jules (CS): HeliosThera week0 recap: SOC paused onboarding. Two asks: 1) show end-to-end audit export into their Splunk with signed delivery proof, 2) confirm key-rotation plan that guarantees no gaps for 24-month retention. tagging @Ibrahim and @Marta — this is a medium renewal risk if not cleared by Friday.

Marta (SE): understood. I can run a replay from their presigned S3 to staging HEC and produce a signed manifest (sha256 + timestamps). need presigned URL + HEC token.

Ibrahim (Security): i'll draft a KMS key-policy template restricting usage to the forwarder role + their VPCE and add a rotation overlap with dual-key decrypt for 72h. dropping redacted snippet:
```json
{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Sid":"AllowForwarderOnly","Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::222333444555:role/helios-forwarder"},"Action":["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],"Condition":{"StringEquals":{"aws:SourceVpc":"vpc-0ffee123"}}}]}
```

Hannah (Ops): ops note from internal dry-run: when HEC returned 5xx bursts we saw intermittent drops unless checkpoint persisted. recommended mitigations: persistent checkpointing, idempotency keys, exponential backoff. runbook snippet:
```
# forwarder config
max_batch: 120
batch_timeout_ms: 1500
retries: 6
checkpoint_interval: 30s
idempotency: enabled
```

Marta (SE): i'll include the verification script that compares s3 object counts -> splunk counts and emits a signed manifest. plan to run replay tomorrow morning.

Jules (CS): action items: 1) @Marta request presigned S3 + HEC token from customer by EOD. 2) @Ibrahim post key policy + rotation note. 3) @Hannah run replay and paste pre/post counts + errors. tagging @Omar (Renewals) to mark as watch.

deploy-bot: Reminder — HeliosThera week0 follow-up meeting scheduled 1705005600 (in 6h).

Omar (Renewals): noted. marking account as "watch" in CRM. i'll join the post-replay call and prepare exec-join language if SOC still objects.

Jules (CS): thanks team. i'll update customer once Ibrahim and Marta upload artifacts. leaving thread open for signoff.
